```yaml
name: Update Open WebUI

on:
  schedule:
    # Run weekly on Monday at 00:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  sync-open-webui:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Clone open-webui as shallow copy
        run: |
          # Remove existing folder if it exists to ensure clean state
          rm -rf open-webui
          # Clone as shallow copy without .git directory to save space and avoid submodule issues
          git clone --depth 1 --no-tags https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui.git open-webui-temp
          # Remove .git directory to exclude from builds and avoid submodule leftovers
          rm -rf open-webui-temp/.git
          # Move to final location
          mv open-webui-temp open-webui

      - name: Update contributor docs
        run: |
          # Create or update a note in CONTRIBUTING.md or similar doc if it exists
          if [ -f "CONTRIBUTING.md" ]; then
            if ! grep -q "open-webui folder" "CONTRIBUTING.md"; then
              echo "" >> "CONTRIBUTING.md"
              echo "## Open WebUI Integration" >> "CONTRIBUTING.md"
              echo "The \`open-webui/\` folder contains a synced copy of the open-webui repository." >> "CONTRIBUTING.md"
              echo "This is updated automatically via the 'Update Open WebUI' workflow." >> "CONTRIBUTING.md"
            fi
          fi

      - name: Update README
        run: |
          # Mention automated sync in README if not already present
          if [ -f "README.md" ]; then
            if ! grep -q "automated sync" "README.md"; then
              echo "" >> "README.md"
              echo "## Automated Sync" >> "README.md"
              echo "This repository includes an automated weekly sync of the open-webui project." >> "README.md"
            fi
          fi

      - name: Commit and push changes
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          author_name: "GitHub Actions Bot"
          author_email: "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          message: "chore: sync open-webui weekly"
          add: "open-webui CONTRIBUTING.md README.md"
          push: true
```
